title: Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum
summary: Hand drum with a reduced Perform song list. It lacks the three Digital Deluxe songs even when the DLC is unlocked.

fields.Perform: With Musical Instrument proficiency, play Bard Dance, Old Time Battles or The Power as a free action.
fields.Song exclusions: This drum lacks Of Divinity and Sin, The Queen’s High Seas and Sing for Me.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Thomas C. Quirkilious at the Chromatic Scale.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
